subject: SternBank: request for routing + audit export (activation gating)
messages:
From: Alicia Vargas <alicia.vargas@sternbank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SternBank — production gating: request for routing/audit export timeline

Hi Stephanie / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and our infra team have one gating ask before we can sign the final order: SternBank requires deterministic routing for a small percentage of requests (10%) to a pinned residency and an exportable per-request audit trace (CSV or JSON) that includes routeId, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, and an immutable traceId.

We attached the updated requirements and a draft SOW (sternbank_SOW_v3.pdf). High level:
- Pilot: 10% of traffic, US-only, 6-week pilot
- Audit export cadence: daily CSV export for audit team, plus ad-hoc export via API
- Data residency: pinned to our VPC for the pilot

We understand this is an "exception" ask — can you provide a firm timeline and estimate? Legal needs anything by Oct 10 to finish procurement approval. If a smaller scoped change (feature flag + export hook) is possible sooner, we can accept a staged acceptance.

Attachment: sternbank_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: sternbank_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can align internal signoffs.

Best,
Alicia Vargas
Head of Infrastructure Engineering
SternBank

- We’ll aim to give you a preliminary commitment by EOD Oct 4 and a delivery plan by Oct 6 so Legal can proceed.

Marissa / Ben — looping you in. Key asks from SternBank attached: pinned residency for 10% of traffic, daily exports + ad-hoc export API, immutable traceId per request. Legal asks for an initial timeline by Oct 10.

Proposed next step: 30-min triage call today or tomorrow to align scope (pilot vs full feature). Monica — can you propose 2 slots?

Thanks,

Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SternBank — production gating: request for routing/audit export timeline

Triage notes from eng (quick technical read):

I reviewed the attachments. Narrowing down dependencies/questions so we can scope:
1) Deterministic routing: do you mean true session pinning (same route for subsequent requests) or just one-off sticky routing per request? Persistent pinning requires non-trivial placement (pools, affinity table) and affects autoscaling.
2) Audit export: we already capture traceId and route metadata internally, but supporting a daily CSV dump and an "on-demand" export endpoint is mostly plumbing (ETL + permissions).
3) Pilot constraints: pin to a dedicated VPC pool is infra work (networking + KMS). If SternBank can accept "soft-pinning" (route variants with affinity for 7 days) we can reduce scope.

Rough estimate (ballpark):
- Minimal staged approach (feature flag + export hook + affinity token): ~6 dev days + 3 QA days + infra config (1-2 infra engineer days). Goal: 2-week turnaround if we prioritize and reduce scope.
- Full deterministic residency (dedicated pool + export): ~4-6 sprints depending on infra runway.

Action items for scoping call: confirm exact pinning semantics, target SSO/KMS requirements for backup keys, and whether exports have filtering/redaction needs.

If product can greenlight the minimal staged approach, I can carve out a small spike this week.

-Ben
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SternBank — production gating: request for routing/audit export timeline

Thanks Ben — that aligns with what SternBank is willing to accept. Their procurement priority is speed to pilot (Legal needs dates). They confirmed on a call earlier that a staged delivery with soft-pinning + daily CSV would be acceptable for the first 6 weeks.

Proposed negotiation fallback (if full residency is too slow):
- Stage 1 (2 weeks): feature flag enabling soft-affinity + daily export, ad-hoc export for auditors
- Stage 2 (sprint 2+): hardened deterministic routing + dedicated pool if adoption/latency warrants it

SternBank is flexible on payment terms if we can get Stage 1 live by Oct 25. They attached an updated SOW with a payment milestone tied to pilot start (sternbank_proposal_estimate.csv).

Can product confirm whether Stage 1 is acceptable to slot in a mini-sprint? Marissa — asking for a quick thumbs up so we can update Legal & Procurement.

-Monica
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SternBank — production gating: request for routing/audit export timeline

On Wed, Oct 3, 2028 at 09:10 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — that aligns with what SternBank is willing to accept.
> Proposed negotiation fallback: Stage 1 (2 weeks): feature flag enabling soft-affinity + daily export

Thanks all — after reviewing the ask and the business impact (strategic regional anchor customer), Product approves a Stage 1 mini-sprint with the following guardrails:

Acceptance criteria (Stage 1):
- Soft-affinity implemented behind a feature flag (no guaranteed hard pinning)
- Daily audit CSV export with columns: timestamp, traceId, routeId, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, residency_tag
- On-demand export API for auditors (RBAC limited to SternBank auditors)
- No changes to default autoscaling; infra to validate capacity impact in sandbox

Risk notes: feature flag must default off; we will not enable for >10% traffic in pilot without infra sign-off. Engineering to provide performance regression data before pilot.

Ben — please create a JIRA (JIRA-INF-2149) with the scope above and a small spike to confirm KMS/network requirements. If the spike shows low friction we will resource a 2-week sprint starting Oct 16.

Monica / Stephanie — update SternBank: we can commit to a staged delivery and will provide a detailed plan by Oct 6 (as requested). Legal can proceed with those dates.

-Marissa Cole
Head of Product — Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
